historySubtitle: 您的历史记录为 Today Hub 的准备情况和获胜分数提供动力。
historyAvgVolume: 最近趋势：过去 5 个月的平均成交量：{{avg}} {{unit}}。
historyEmptyDesc: 完成一项主动锻炼即可在此处查看。
historyPillarWinsDesc: 流动性获胜、思维提示、从支柱记录的评估都出现在这里（与营养的协同作用）。 免费核心。
historyVolumeDesc: 每周总计 {{unit}} × 次数（过去 12 周）
historyDayEmpty: Nothing was recorded on this day.
historyDayBadDate: That is not a date. Pick a day from your history.
historyHeatmapDesc: 按组划分的成交量 — 过去 {{days}} 天。 颜色越深=工作量越大； 浅绿色=准备训练。
historySignInFoot: 登录（可选）以加载完整的云历史记录。
historyBriefingEmpty: Your mission story starts with the first logged set.
anatomyMapLead: Tap a region for exercises. Color = recent volume; red = overdue.
journalEmptyDesc: Finish a session and its debrief is kept here. Jot a field note mid-workout and it opens the entry in your own words.
journalPrivacyLine: Your journal stays on this device. It is never uploaded.
journalNoMatches: Nothing in the journal matches that.
journalEditPlaceholder: One note per line — your words, kept verbatim.
historyEditConfirmDesc: This updates the session you logged. Coach and History will use the new numbers. The session is not deleted.
historyEditEmptyDesc: Empty invents nothing — this session stays as it was.
historyBackfillDesc: If you trained and never opened the app, log that session with the date it happened. Empty invents nothing.
historyBackfillEmptyDesc: Empty invents nothing — pick a date and the sets you remember.
historyBackfillTimingOff: Timing is off — duration is omitted. The date still stands.
historyMergeDesc: If you logged the same movement under two names, pick which name to keep. This cannot be undone.
historyMergeConfirmDesc: All history, PRs, notes, tags, rest, and 1RM from {{source}} move onto {{keeper}}. This cannot be undone.
historyMergeEmptyDesc: Empty invents nothing — pick two different names that already exist.
historyMergeDoneDesc: History, PRs, notes, and rest now use the name you kept.
historyDeleteConfirmDesc: This session leaves History. Restore it from Deleted sessions. Other days stay.
historyRestoreDesc: Restore a session you deleted. Empty invents nothing. A live workout is not this.
historyStartFromDesc: Week strip, Coach, and streak start here. Older sessions stay in History. Empty invents nothing.
historyStartFromActive: Week 1 starts {{date}}. Older days stay in History.
historyStartFromEmptyDesc: Empty invents nothing — pick a date that is not in the future.
historyStartFromConfirmTitle: Fold older days out of week 1?
historyStartFromConfirmDesc: This folds {{count}} training days out of the week strip, Coach, and streak. Sessions stay in History.
historyExportDesc: Save the sessions you logged as a file. Empty invents nothing. Deleted sessions stay out.
historyImportDesc: Bring back the file you saved. Confirm before it writes. Empty invents nothing.
historyImportMergeNamed: Merge {{count}} sessions from this file into your diary. Existing sessions stay.
historyImportReplaceConfirm: Replace the diary with {{count}} sessions from this file
historyImportEmptyDesc: Empty invents nothing — pick the CSV or JSON you saved.
historySessionCsvDesc: Bring a workout CSV onto this device. No account. Confirm before it writes. The file you saved here still uses Import this diary.
historySessionCsvReady: Merge {{count}} sessions ({{sets}} sets). {{skipped}} rows skipped. Existing sessions stay.
historySessionCsvEmpty: Empty invents nothing. This door reads a session export (Date, Workout Name, Exercise Name, Set Order, Weight, Reps) or a set-table export (exercise_title, set_index).
historySessionCsvUnmatched: {{count}} exercise names are not in the library. The sets stay under the name in the file.
historySessionCsvAlready: Those sessions are already in this diary. Nothing new to merge.
